title: Owner Earning Rate for Vehicles Bought from the Group — Kessler Owner Rewards Gold and Platinum, Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Benefit schedule.** On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders account at Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum, the earning rate on a paid repair order follows how its vehicle was bought, as the customer's Vehicle Purchase Agreements records show. The vehicle is the vehicle on the paid repair order's labor charges.

| Vehicle's purchase with the group | Account tier | Earning rate (points per dollar) |
|---|---|---|
| Closed purchase deal financed on a dealer-arranged installment contract | Gold or Platinum | the tier's points per dollar plus 2 |
| Closed purchase deal paid in cash or through an outside lender | Gold or Platinum | the tier's points per dollar plus 1 |
| Any other case | — | the tier's points per dollar, with no addition |

A deal counts only once its status is closed; the way it was paid is the financing recorded on the deal.

**Cases (hypothetical, a tier earning 3 points per dollar).** Vehicle bought on a closed installment deal arranged by the store: 5 points per dollar. Bought for cash: 4 points per dollar. Vehicle never bought from the group: 3 points per dollar.
